facts.label: Clyburn Center for Primary Health, Aiken

sections.title: Clyburn Center for *Primary Health*
body: Aiken had an acute care facility on the west side and primary care physicians on the Southside, but downtown and Northside residents had few, if any, health-care options. A local group of health-care professionals and residents identified the need and secured land for a new center.

The 26,000 square foot Clyburn Center includes adult and pediatric medicine, an OB-GYN department, optometry and dental care. Demand for more examination and treatment rooms later led to a new Women's Health Facility, with mammography, ultrasound and pediatric medicine.
